# netactuate_bgp_asn (Data Source)

Reads a BGP ASN.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_bgp_asn" "example" {
  bgp_asn_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bgp_asn_id` (Number) BGP ASN ID to read.

### Read-Only

- `asn` (Number) Autonomous system number.
- `group_type` (String) BGP group type.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String) ASN name.
